subject.title: fix(cli): protect protocol stdout during startup

question: Should maintainers restore this PR to the narrow protocol-stdout fix, or intentionally keep the current broad stacked head for separate review?
rationale: The current broad head was added by maintainer-side commits after a prior comment said the PR was still the two-file MCP stdout lane, so automation should not silently delete or land those changes without maintainer intent.

options.title: Restore the narrow bugfix
options.body: Keep only the CLI path-policy/startup-policy/test changes needed to protect MCP/ACP protocol stdout, then rerun exact-head CI.

options.title: Split the stacked work
options.body: Move the Android, iOS, audit, provider, workflow, extension, and generated changes into separate purpose-built PRs before reviewing this bugfix.

options.title: Close and replace
options.body: Close this PR as no longer a clean landing lane and open a maintainer-owned replacement that preserves contributor credit for the original stdout fix.

recommendation.title: Restore the narrow bugfix
recommendation.body: Keep only the CLI path-policy/startup-policy/test changes needed to protect MCP/ACP protocol stdout, then rerun exact-head CI.

likelyOwner.reason: `vincentkoc` is the assignee and authored the current broad maintainer-side commits, so they are best positioned to confirm whether the branch drift was intentional.
